primary_hypothesis.text: Under matched resources, full ORION improves the official discovery metric or complete-gold paper recall over strong lexical, dense/hybrid and agentic single-route baselines without increasing premature task closure.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Routes that earn independence contribute more unique relevant evidence than nominally distinct shared-backend routes.
Typed route-stop/task-stop separation reduces premature task closure at bounded cost.
Question/content-version-aware read state reduces redundant processing without suppressing legitimate rereads.

resource_policy: Freeze and match query count, model/tool-call budget and wall-clock ceiling per benchmark family. Deterministic lexical baselines run on the same frozen corpus/snapshot. Live-provider mutability is reported separately from algorithmic performance.
exclusion_policy: Provider unavailability, transport failure, empty results, agent timeout and malformed output are retained. Infrastructure exclusions are allowed only under a symmetric predeclared outage rule and remain visible in the archive.

statistics.unit: benchmark query/topic; repeated agent runs nested within query/system
statistics.interval: Official benchmark aggregation plus paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) over matched queries; Wilson intervals for stopping/error rates
statistics.multiplicity: Primary metric is benchmark-family specific (Deep, Wide, complete-gold). Holm correction for inferential secondary route/stopping families.
statistics.practical_margin: Design target: +0.03 absolute recall/official score versus the strongest matched baseline where scale is [0,1], with premature task closure not worse. If raw recall is equivalent, a safety/cost advantage must satisfy a separately frozen non-inferiority rule before execution.

access_policy.hidden_labels: Gold target/qualifying sets and screening labels are not provided to the candidate except where the official benchmark protocol explicitly exposes information.
access_policy.evaluator_custody: Official evaluators or frozen host-owned complete-gold evaluator; candidate outputs cannot modify evaluator state.
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: Live web/search routes record benchmark-answer/metadata exposure; contaminated public-benchmark cases are reported separately and do not silently support the headline claim.
access_policy.access_logging: All route requests, raw results, query derivations, transport failures, provider timestamps and content identities are retained.
